clauses.anchor: Required deliverables item 1 (file list): "scripts/components/rescuedispatch_replica.lua"

Required deliverables item 2 (API block Dispatch.new/load, update_player, request, volunteer, heartbeat, complete, cancel, tick, snapshot, save): "Pure module exports"; Background and goal: "Implement a plain Lua dispatcher"
clauses.note: every hidden case loads the module in a sandbox without engine globals or require, but complete() and cancel() are never called by any case

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 1, first sentence: "Time must be finite, non-negative and must not move the global clock backwards"
clauses.note: no case passes a non-finite, negative or regressing time

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 1, second sentence: "stale updates have no side effects"
clauses.note: no case sends a stale or repeated revision

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 2: "an invalid or non-finite health ratio must be rejected"
clauses.note: cases only require that valid records are accepted (fresh(): update_player(...) ~= false) and that a newer record takes effect; no invalid record or health ratio is ever submitted

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 3, first sentence: "Incidents are ordered by effective severity descending, creation time ascending, then target ID in lexicographic order"
clauses.note: only severity-descending is decisive (hidden/rescue-dispatch-queue.lua:16-22); an implementation that ignores creation time and target id passes

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 3, second sentence: "must not depend on how often `tick` is called"
clauses.note: aging_interval=20 and no case lets 20 time units pass; aging is never observable

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 4, first sentence: "One helper holds at most one live lease, and one target has at most one helper"
Core semantics item 4, second sentence: "Lease IDs are generated by an internal stable sequence"
clauses.note: checked only as 'a new lease gets a different id' and 'a retry returns the same id'; the sequence itself and its persistence are not checked

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 5: "must first deduplicate by helper/request ID, and then create a lease for the current highest-priority unassigned incident"
Core semantics item 6, first sentence: "Only a live lease belonging to the matching helper can be targeted by heartbeat or complete"
clauses.note: only the expired-lease heartbeat is rejected (line 39); a heartbeat by a different helper and complete() are never tried

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 6: "A heartbeat sets the expiry time to a deterministic new boundary"
clauses.note: heartbeat is only required to return ok after load (line 68); the new expires_at is never read

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 6: "reaching the boundary counts as expired"
clauses.note: tick/volunteer/heartbeat exactly at lease.expires_at (lines 36-39)

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 7, first sentence: "Expiry, helper disconnect or helper death releases the helper and requeues the unresolved target exactly once"
clauses.note: expiry and helper disconnect are exercised; helper death and the exactly-once count are not

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 7, second sentence: "Target recovery, death, disconnect or cancel ends the incident"
clauses.note: only recovery (health_percent=1) is exercised; target death, target disconnect and cancel() are not. The recovery threshold is not defined publicly

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 8: "is stably ordered by queue and by lease and does not expose personal request history"
clauses.note: cases read only #snapshot.queue and #snapshot.leases and that mutating a snapshot does not change state; ordering and absence of history are not checked

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 8: "must preserve the idempotency history and the lease boundaries"
clauses.note: the active lease must survive (heartbeat ok, one lease); idempotent history after load and the expiry boundary value are not checked

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 1: "The master simulation world component" (component on the master-simulation world)
clauses.note: server case asserts TheWorld.ismastersim and TheWorld.components.rescuedispatch; plus source gate rescue-authority

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 1: "client coordinates or severity may only serve as non-authoritative hints"
clauses.note: the server case uses real health components but would also pass if health were never read; position is covered only by the source pattern 'Transform:GetWorldPosition'

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 2: "Listen for `ms_playerjoined`, `ms_playerleft` and the player's `healthdelta`, `death`, `respawnfromghost`, `onremove`" (restated in the Base-game API contract listing)
clauses.note: source pattern only; no event is pushed by the server suite

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 3: "The RPC handler obtains the helper identity from `player.userid` and accepts only request/lease identifiers" (restated at the end of Base-game API contract)
clauses.note: source pattern 'AddModRPCHandler(' only

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 4: "when the component is removed, cancel the task and unregister all events"
clauses.note: source patterns ':Cancel(' and 'RemoveEventCallback(' only; the component is never removed

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 5: "publish a compact, read-only task state without private request history"
clauses.note: source patterns only; the published value is never read

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 6: "Persist the dispatcher through `OnSave/OnLoad`"
clauses.note: server case round-trips OnSave/OnLoad on the live component (but see known_issues for the receiver-less call); plus source pattern ':OnSave('

clauses.anchor: Base-game API contract item 1: "Unregistering a listener must use the same callback and source as at registration"
clauses.note: source patterns only

clauses.anchor: Base-game API contract item 2: "The replica and the netvar must be set up before the client early return" with the net_string(inst.GUID, ...) block
clauses.note: source patterns 'net_string(' / 'AddReplicableComponent(' only; no client exists in the run

clauses.anchor: Base-game API contract item 3: "The server-side component must expose"
clauses.note: UpdatePlayer, Request and Volunteer are called; Heartbeat and Tick are never referenced

clauses.anchor: Acceptance item 1: "Ordering is not affected by insertion order or by `pairs` order"
clauses.note: one fixed insertion order with two incidents

clauses.anchor: Acceptance item 2: "A helper/target never has two live leases at the same time"
Acceptance item 3: "A late heartbeat must not revive an expired lease"
Acceptance item 4: "Disconnect, death, recovery and reload all correctly release or keep tasks"
clauses.note: disconnect, recovery and reload are exercised; death is not

clauses.anchor: Acceptance item 5: "The headless dedicated server test creates server entities with the base-game `health` component"
clauses.note: the mod must load on the dedicated server and the lease and save/load assertions run; no real event is triggered and net state and cleanup are not asserted, contrary to the public sentence

clauses.anchor: Acceptance closing line: "Only base-game APIs and assets may be used, and authoritative dispatch must not be placed in the replica"
clauses.note: no case inspects the replica or the assets

clauses.anchor: Return values and data shapes items 1-2: "counts as recovered" (recovery_threshold defaults to 0.75, health_percent >= threshold counts as recovered)
Return values and data shapes items 4-6: "returns a new table containing a boolean `ok` and `target_id`" (request/volunteer/heartbeat fields ok, target_id, lease_id, expires_at = now + lease_ttl)
Return values and data shapes item 7: "The top level of `snapshot(now)` contains the array `queue`"
Return values and data shapes item 8: "returns a table containing `ok` and `target_id`, where `target_id` is the `userid` of the target player"
